title: Voyager 1 Is Still Calling Home From 15 Billion Miles Away #Shorts
description:
Launched by NASA from Florida in 1977, Voyager 1 is now over 15 billion miles away in interstellar space—the farthest human-made object in history. Its radio signal takes nearly 23 hours to reach Earth, and bolted to its hull is the Golden Record built to outlast humanity.
